Name: Operating checking
Notes: Card processor deposits and cash deposits land here

Name: Cash drawer
Notes: Cash taken at the front desk and not yet deposited

Name: Retail inventory
Notes: Product bought to resell. Optional on cash basis; use it if you count the retail wall

Name: Accounts payable
Notes: Distributor and supplier invoices not yet paid

Name: Tips payable
Notes: Card tips collected, waiting to be paid to staff through payroll. Should net to zero after each payroll

Name: Gift cards and packages outstanding
Notes: Sold, not yet redeemed. Becomes revenue when the service is used

Name: Sales tax payable
Notes: Tax collected on retail and any taxable services

Name: Payroll liabilities
Notes: Withholdings and employer taxes, from the payroll report

Name: Business credit card
Notes: The payment from checking is a transfer, not an expense

Name: Service revenue
Notes: Cuts, color, treatments, massage, nails. Spas often add one account per service line

Name: Gift card and package redemptions
Notes: Optional. Services paid for earlier with a gift card or package

Name: Salon supplies (backbar)
Notes: Color, developer, disposables, towels and laundry used on clients

Name: Wages and commissions
Notes: Gross pay from the payroll report

Name: Payroll taxes
Notes: Employer share from the payroll report

Name: Merchant fees
Notes: Card processor and booking app payment fees
